items.title: What Is Ross Stores (ROST) Signaling With Higher 2026 Guidance And More Stores?
items.summary: Ross Stores (NasdaqGS:ROST) has significantly raised its full year 2026 earnings guidance, indicating higher expected profitability for the period. The company has also expanded its 2026 new store opening plans, indicating a larger physical footprint than previously outlined. Management linked the updated outlook and store rollout to improving business momentum and confidence in the operating environment.
